---
title: FluxScript diagnostics
description: Every diagnostic code the FluxScript compiler reports, with its severity, generated from the code registry.
---

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/docs/fluxscript-diagnostics.mjs from DSL_CODES in @fluxion/dsl: do not edit by hand. -->

The compiler reports a problem as one line: its place (`L<line>:<col>`), its severity, its code, a message and, when it can, a
fix (`hint:`). Codes are stable: new ones are added, none is renamed. The compiler also reports the document schema's codes
(`FLX_REF_MISSING`, `FLX_TOKEN_UNKNOWN`, `FLX_SCHEMA_*`), listed in the diagnostics reference of the file format.

| Code | Severity | When |
|---|---|---|
| `FLX_DSL_AMBIGUOUS_SHAPE` | error | A short shape name that more than one used pack defines. |
| `FLX_DSL_BAD_SLUG` | error | A slug or screen id that is not lower-case `[a-z][a-z0-9-]*`. |
| `FLX_DSL_DUP_SLUG` | error | A node or group slug used twice in the document. |
| `FLX_DSL_EDGE_SYNTAX` | error | An edge that is not `<end> <op> <end>` with one of the five ops. |
| `FLX_DSL_NOT_YET` | warning | A v1 section this compiler keeps in `document.source` but does not compile yet. |
| `FLX_DSL_SYNTAX` | error | YAML that does not parse, or uses anchors, aliases, tags or duplicate keys. |
| `FLX_DSL_UNKNOWN_KEY` | error | A key the v1 grammar does not have at that position. |
| `FLX_DSL_UNKNOWN_PACK` | warning | A pack in `uses:` that is not registered; its shapes are then unknown. |
| `FLX_DSL_UNKNOWN_SHAPE` | error | A shape not found through the packs in `uses:`. |
| `FLX_DSL_VERSION` | error | `flux` is missing, or is not 1. |
